name: Luigi Colosimo
bioAdditions: Luigi (Aloysius) was baptized on Christmas Day 1795, son of Giovanni Colosimo and Teresa Cicco (S1). He married Carmela Moraca, daughter of the late Alessio, on 29 January 1818 (S2). He was buried on 14 April 1864, a fortnight after his wife (S3).

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Baptism, marriage and burial indexed; son Raffaele's records name him.
